title: Authentication
snippet:
Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header. [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.
```
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```
The API host is `https://api.waterfall.io`. Data endpoints use `/v1/`; Account Reporter V2 uses `/v2/account`. Use the path shown on each reference page.
##
​
Best practices
- Store keys in server-side environment variables. Keep them out of browser code and public repositories.
- Rotate keys periodically.
- Use [dedicated sub-keys](/v1/api-keys-overview) to manage access and usage for separate teams or workflows. Creating and managing sub-keys requires a **master API key**.
Missing keys return `401`. Invalid keys return `403`; this status can also indicate that a feature or permission is unavailable to the key. Inspect the error `code` using the [Errors guide](/v1/errors). Follow the [quickstart](/v1/quickstart) to make your first request, or use [Agent Skills](/v1/skills-overview) to build with an agent.

title: Waterfall API introduction
snippet:
The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header. See [Authentication](/v1/authentication).
## Endpoints
| API | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Prospector](/v1/prospector-launcher) | Async | Find people at a company by domain and title filters, with available emails and optional phones. |
| [Search Contact](/v1/search-contact-launcher) | Sync | Find profiles by LinkedIn, company, or supported company-set and role filters. Emails and phones are excluded. |
| [Search Company](/v1/search-company-launcher) | Sync | Find companies by industry, headquarters country, or headcount range. Preview. |
| [Contact Enrichment](/v1/contact-enrichment-launcher) | Async | Find profile data and available contact details from an email, LinkedIn identifier, or name and company domain. |
| [Phone Enrichment](/v1/phone-enrichment-launcher) | Async | Find available phone numbers for a known person. |
| [Company Enrichment](/v1/company-enrichment-launcher) | Async | Find company details from a domain, LinkedIn identifier, or company name. |
| [Company Reveal](/v1/company-reveal-launcher) | Sync | Look up company context from an IPv4 address, with entity type and confidence. |
| [Company Titles](/v1/company-titles-launcher) | Sync | Retrieve active job titles at a company by domain or LinkedIn identifier. Preview; requires access on your key. |
| [Job Change](/v1/job-change-launcher) | Sync | Check a contact’s company information and return an employment-change outcome with an available profile. |
| [Email Verification](/v1/email-verifier) | Sync | Check a specific email address and return its verification status. |
| [Webhook JWKS](/v1/webhook-jwks) | Sync | Fetch public Ed25519 keys for verifying signed webhook deliveries. |
| [Account Reporting](/v1/account-reporter-v2) | Sync | Read usage for the account and authenticated key, plus the current account balance. |
| [API Key Management](/v1/api-keys-overview) | Sync | List account keys and create or update sub-keys using a master key. |

## Manage your integration
- [API Keys Management](/v1/api-keys-overview): create and manage keys for your workflows.
- [Usage Tracking](/v1/inline-usage): inspect a job’s returned cost and balance snapshot.
- [Account Reporting](/v1/account-reporter-v2): read usage across a date range.
- [Webhook Verification](/v1/webhook-verification): verify the origin and integrity of signed deliveries.

title: API Keys Management
snippet:
Use a Waterfall master API key to create, list, and modify sub-keys for your account. Separate keys let you track usage by team, environment, or integration and manage each key’s active status and request rate limit.
These operations require a master API key. Contact your account manager if you need key management enabled for your account.
##
​
Available operations
| Operation | Endpoint | Use it to |
|---|---|---|
| [List keys](/v1/api-keys-list) | `GET /v1/api-keys` | Review keys and their current settings. |
| [Create a key](/v1/api-keys-create) | `POST /v1/api-keys` | Add a sub-key with a label and request rate limit. |
| [Modify a key](/v1/api-keys-modify) | `PUT /v1/api-keys` | Update a sub-key’s label, active status, or request rate limit. |
Authenticate these requests with your master key in `x-api-key`. The master key cannot be modified through these endpoints.
##
​
Track usage by integration
Give each sub-key a clear `notes` label, such as `crm-production` or `signup-enrichment`. Authenticate [Account Reporter](/v1/account-reporter-v2) with that key to compare its `key_usage` with overall `account_usage`. `per_interval` controls requests per 60-second interval. It is a request rate limit, not a spending limit. A sub-key’s value cannot exceed the master key’s limit.

title: API Keys - List
snippet:
List the API keys under your account. Use this endpoint to review which keys are active, check their request rate limits, or find the `api_key` value needed to modify a sub-key.
Requires your **master API key** in the `x-api-key` header.
##
​
Next steps
Use [Create a key](/v1/api-keys-create) for a new team or integration. Use [Modify a key](/v1/api-keys-modify) to update an existing sub-key’s label, active status, or request rate limit. For usage counters and current account balance, use [Account Reporter](/v1/account-reporter-v2).
#### Authorizations
To access the API, provide your API key in `x-api-key`.
#### Response
API keys list returned
Response containing the list of API keys for the authenticated account.
​
api_keys
object[] | null
required
Your account API keys
Example:
```
[
{
"api_key": "ad18e456-0dd7-45e1-b094-43a0361aedfa",
"active": true,
"notes": "team-a",
"master": false,
"per_interval": 30,
"interval_seconds": 60
}
]
```

title: API Keys - Create
snippet:
Create a sub-key under your Waterfall account. Each key has a label, active status, and request rate limit. See [API key management](/v1/api-keys-overview) for how sub-keys fit into your integration.
Requires your **master API key** in the `x-api-key` header.

#### Authorizations
To access the API, provide your API key in `x-api-key`.
#### Body
application/json
Create sub-key payload. `notes` is required. `per_interval` is optional; if omitted, the current implementation defaults to 50.

title: Webhook Verification
snippet:
How it works
Waterfall signs each webhook delivery with an Ed25519 private key and puts the result in `X-Webhook-Signature` as a compact JWT. The body payload is not modified. The JWT contains a `body_hash` claim: the unpadded base64url SHA-256 digest of the exact raw request body bytes. Verification has three parts: valid signature, valid claims, matching body hash.
##
​
JWKS endpoint
Waterfall publishes its Ed25519 public keys at:
```
GET https://api.waterfall.io/.well-known/jwks.json
```
Cache the response for 5 minutes (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`). During key rotation, old and new keys overlap for at least the 5-minute cache window so in-flight deliveries continue to verify. See the [Webhook JWKS](/v1/webhook-jwks) reference for the full response schema.

###
​
1. Read the signature header
- Header name: `X-Webhook-Signature`
- Header value: one compact JWT in `header.payload.signature` form
- Reject if absent or larger than 8192 bytes
###
​
2. Decode the JWT
Split on `.`. Base64url-decode each of the three segments (no padding). The protected header must contain:
| Field | Required value |
|---|---|
| `alg` | `EdDSA` |
| `typ` | `JWT` |
| `kid` | non-empty string |
###
​
3. Fetch and cache public keys
Fetch the JWKS and select the key where the JWKS `kid` matches the JWT `kid`. JWK shape: `kty: "OKP"`, `crv: "Ed25519"`, public key bytes in `x`. If the `kid` is not found in a cached response, refresh the JWKS once before rejecting. Throttle forced refreshes to one per 30 seconds.

5. Validate claims
| Claim | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `iat` | integer | Issued-at timestamp (Unix seconds) |
| `exp` | integer | Expiry. Always `iat + 900` (15 minutes). |
| `jti` | string | Unique delivery ID. Use for replay deduplication. |
| `job_id` | string | The Waterfall job this delivery belongs to. |
| `body_hash` | string | Unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the raw request body. |
| `body_hash_alg` | string | Always `sha-256`. |
Validation rules:
- `body_hash_alg` must be `sha-256`
